skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Distant Home's Guide
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Distant Home's Guide. The plainclothes Quercus once wore on an infiltration mission. Principally serving to conceal her identity, so as to better facilitate combat in city environs.
skins.quote: Five people enter an alley, one leaves alive. From here on, home is a distant thing, and the rootless trees are set to drift alone.

skins.name: The Bard's Tale
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/The Bard's Tale. This player shall be the one singing ballads for the heroes of old, livening up the tavern with her ditties. Come, listen close, who stole the melody that wends through the shadow-flickering breeze?
skins.quote: There are many who believe themselves dashing and humorous, more than enough to take on the role of a wandering bard, but Quercus's improvised performance is not something just anyone can learn.
